description: ACCDB: seed T(ID PK, D DATETIME2); test SQL UPDATE transitions (ISO string, #date#, Null, Null->value), DAO dynaset Edit/Update (ISO string & VT_DATE), and invalid SQL INSERT/UPDATE + DAO Field.Value puts ('not-a-date', '2026-02-30', '2026-13-01', '0000-12-31 23:59:59.9999999', '10000-01-01 00:00:00.0000000', '2026-03-05 25:00:00', 12345, 1.5). Keeps all pages at every step.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, D DATETIME2)
UPDATE T SET D = #2026-03-05 13:45:01# WHERE ID = 3
UPDATE T SET D = Null WHERE ID = 4
SELECT ID, D FROM T WHERE ID IN (1, 5) ORDER BY ID
UPDATE T SET D = 'not-a-date' WHERE ID = 1
SELECT ID, D FROM T ORDER BY ID
